blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Hundreds of indigenous residents and farming households in an upland village in San Miguel, Surigao del Sur, will gain reliable access to clean water. This became possible after a tripartite agreement was signed on Oct. 29 to fast-track vital rural infrastructure in the indigenous residents’ ancestral domain, worth P38 million. The initiative is part of a broader development package unanimously approved by the Caraga Regional Project Advisory Board (RPAB), which endorsed two priority projects inside Certificate of Ancestral Domain Title (CADT) 116 in Barangay Umalag: the P6-million Rehabilitation and Improvement of the Barangay Umalag Potable […]...
